Run `wrangler secret put JWT_SECRET` to provision the JWT signing secret in Cloudflare Secret Manager (bound at runtime as env.JWT_SECRET). To provision the D1 database, run `wrangler d1 create niruvi_store_d1` and replace d1_databases[0].database_id below with the generated UUID.
